package nats

import (
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
)

const validPlannerOnboardingPathOutcome = `{
  "event_id":"11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111",
  "event_type":"planner.onboarding-path.outcome.v1",
  "correlation_id":"22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
  "causation_id":"33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333",
  "student_id":"44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444",
  "occurred_at":"2026-09-11T12:00:00Z",
  "schema_version":1,
  "data":{
    "schema":"planner-onboarding-path-outcome.v1",
    "execution_id":"22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
    "handoff_id":"33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333",
    "student_id":"44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444",
    "dialog_id":"55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555",
    "teacher_job_id":"66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666",
    "status":"PATH_READY",
    "course_id":"77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777",
    "learning_path_id":"88888888-8888-4888-8888-888888888888",
    "first_lesson_id":"99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999"
  }
}`

func TestDecodePlannerOnboardingPathOutcome(t *testing.T) {
	outcome, err := DecodePlannerOnboardingPathOutcome([]byte(validPlannerOnboardingPathOutcome))
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, domain.TeacherOnboardingPathReady, outcome.Status)
	require.Equal(t, outcome.CorrelationID, outcome.ExecutionID)
	require.Equal(t, outcome.CausationID, outcome.HandoffID)
	require.NotEmpty(t, outcome.FirstLessonID)
}

func TestDecodePlannerOnboardingPathOutcomeRequiresStatusSpecificIDs(t *testing.T) {
	for _, status := range []string{domain.TeacherOnboardingPathActiveExists, domain.TeacherOnboardingPathStateChanged} {
		payload := strings.Replace(validPlannerOnboardingPathOutcome, `"status":"PATH_READY"`, `"status":"`+status+`"`, 1)
		_, err := DecodePlannerOnboardingPathOutcome([]byte(payload))
		require.Error(t, err, status)
	}
	conflict := strings.Replace(validPlannerOnboardingPathOutcome, `"status":"PATH_READY",
    "course_id":"77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777",`, `"status":"ACTIVE_PATH_EXISTS",`, 1)
	_, err := DecodePlannerOnboardingPathOutcome([]byte(conflict))
	require.Error(t, err)
	for _, field := range []string{"course_id", "learning_path_id", "first_lesson_id"} {
		explicitNull := strings.Replace(validPlannerOnboardingPathOutcome, `"status":"PATH_READY",`, `"status":"ACTIVE_PATH_EXISTS",`, 1)
		explicitNull = strings.Replace(explicitNull, `"`+field+`":"`+map[string]string{
			"course_id":        "77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777",
			"learning_path_id": "88888888-8888-4888-8888-888888888888",
			"first_lesson_id":  "99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999",
		}[field]+`"`, `"`+field+`":null`, 1)
		_, err := DecodePlannerOnboardingPathOutcome([]byte(explicitNull))
		require.Error(t, err, field+" explicit null must be rejected for a non-ready outcome")
	}
}

func TestDecodePlannerOnboardingPathOutcomeRejectsUnknownAndMismatchedFields(t *testing.T) {
	unknown := strings.Replace(validPlannerOnboardingPathOutcome, `"status":"PATH_READY"`, `"status":"PATH_READY","raw_provider_error":"secret"`, 1)
	_, err := DecodePlannerOnboardingPathOutcome([]byte(unknown))
	require.Error(t, err)
	mismatch := strings.Replace(validPlannerOnboardingPathOutcome, `"student_id":"44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444"`, `"student_id":"aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa"`, 1)
	_, err = DecodePlannerOnboardingPathOutcome([]byte(mismatch))
	require.Error(t, err)
	_, err = DecodePlannerOnboardingPathOutcome(append([]byte(validPlannerOnboardingPathOutcome), []byte(` {}`)...))
	require.Error(t, err, "trailing JSON must be rejected")
}
